meta.title: Yanyan toolkit
meta.description: Injects a context occupancy reading at the first step of every turn and reminds once per tier (handover, compact soon, nearly full), each tier once per session. At the handover threshold it also writes a handover template file next to the clock file (the filename carries the date and the last 8 characters of the session id; an existing file is never overwritten or appended to) and injects only its path. A periodic clock line (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, with the current occupancy when readable) is appended every 6 hours by default and once at process start. Also reminds you to rotate to a new session on a chosen schedule (interval, weekly, or monthly), leaving a rotation marker line in the clock file. Every injection can be scoped per session (scopeSessions): leave it empty to reach all sessions, or list session ids or prefixes to inject only in matching sessions; the clock line is unaffected. Nothing is injected while occupancy is unavailable. Configure it under Settings, in the left navigation entry Yanyan toolkit — not on the plugin page.
